name.text: W09_Q01: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: What is the primary biblical motivation for Christian service?

generalfeedback.text: Christian service is motivated by love for God and selfless devotion to others, seeking God's glory rather than personal praise.

answer.text: Gaining popularity and winning student council elections

feedback.text: Incorrect. Christian service is motivated by love for God and selfless devotion to others, seeking God's glory rather than personal praise.

answer.text: Loving God and selflessly meeting the needs of others as unto Jesus Christ

feedback.text: Correct! Christian service is motivated by love for God and selfless devotion to others, seeking God's glory rather than personal praise.

answer.text: Demanding monetary tips for every household chore

feedback.text: Incorrect. Christian service is motivated by love for God and selfless devotion to others, seeking God's glory rather than personal praise.

answer.text: Showing off superior talents to make others feel inferior

feedback.text: Incorrect. Christian service is motivated by love for God and selfless devotion to others, seeking God's glory rather than personal praise.

answer.text: Boasting when you succeed in school exams

feedback.text: Incorrect. 1 Peter 2:19-20 teaches that patiently enduring suffering for doing what is right is commendable and gracious in God's sight.

feedback.text: Correct! 1 Peter 2:19-20 teaches that patiently enduring suffering for doing what is right is commendable and gracious in God's sight.

feedback.text: Incorrect. 1 Peter 2:19-20 teaches that patiently enduring suffering for doing what is right is commendable and gracious in God's sight.

answer.text: Refusing to work unless you receive praise

feedback.text: Incorrect. 1 Peter 2:19-20 teaches that patiently enduring suffering for doing what is right is commendable and gracious in God's sight.

name.text: W09_Q04: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: How did Jesus respond when He was reviled and insulted during His trial and crucifixion, according to 1 Peter 2:23?

generalfeedback.text: 1 Peter 2:23 states: "When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but continued entrusting himself to him who judges justly."

answer.text: He called down fire from heaven on His accusers

feedback.text: Incorrect. 1 Peter 2:23 states: "When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but continued entrusting himself to him who judges justly."

answer.text: He did not revile in return, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly

feedback.text: Correct! 1 Peter 2:23 states: "When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but continued entrusting himself to him who judges justly."

feedback.text: Incorrect. 1 Peter 2:23 states: "When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but continued entrusting himself to him who judges justly."

feedback.text: Incorrect. 1 Peter 2:23 states: "When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but continued entrusting himself to him who judges justly."

name.text: W09_Q05: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: What lesson should students learn from Joseph's conduct when he was tempted in Potiphar's house?

generalfeedback.text: Joseph demonstrated that true integrity means choosing purity and honoring God even when completely unsupervised.

answer.text: That compromise is acceptable when you are in a foreign country

feedback.text: Incorrect. Joseph demonstrated that true integrity means choosing purity and honoring God even when completely unsupervised.

answer.text: That true moral integrity means honoring God and fleeing sin even when no human is watching

feedback.text: Correct! Joseph demonstrated that true integrity means choosing purity and honoring God even when completely unsupervised.

answer.text: That wealth excuses immoral behavior

feedback.text: Incorrect. Joseph demonstrated that true integrity means choosing purity and honoring God even when completely unsupervised.

answer.text: That arguing with masters is better than doing chores

feedback.text: Incorrect. Joseph demonstrated that true integrity means choosing purity and honoring God even when completely unsupervised.

generalfeedback.text: Servants frequently face ingratitude, peer mockery, false accusations, and weariness (Galatians 6:9; 1 Peter 2:19).

name.text: W09_Q18: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following principles of godly service were demonstrated in the lives of Joseph and Ruth? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Joseph and Ruth exemplified excellence, moral purity, steadfast loyalty, and forgiveness. They never used violence or deceit.
